findings.issue: Wrong reading of 何: before が it is read なに, not なん (なん appears only before だ/で/と/の/counters). 何がそんなにおかしいの is read なにが.
findings.current: なんがそんなにおかしいの?
findings.suggested: なにがそんなにおかしいの?

findings.issue: Token reading for 何 is なん, but before subject particle が the reading is なに in this sentence.
Romaji inherits the wrong reading of 何 (nan instead of nani before が).
かもしれない expresses possibility, but the en asserts certainty, dropping the 'maybe' modality; pt correctly keeps 'talvez' and lit_en keeps 'it may be'.
findings.suggested: It may cost me my job.

findings.issue: 何時間も is emphatic duration ('for hours and hours'); 'until quite some hour' misreads it as a clock-time endpoint (as if it were 何時まで).
findings.current: And, it's because we talked together until quite some hour.
findings.suggested: And, it's because we talked together for hours and hours.

findings.issue: からです marks the sentence as a stated reason; en drops the 'because' while pt keeps it ('E porque conversamos...'), losing the sentence's target grammar point.
findings.current: And we had spent hours talking together.
findings.suggested: And it's because we had spent hours talking together.

findings.issue: pt-BR note uses 'conetiva', which is European-Portuguese orthography; Brazilian Portuguese requires 'conectiva' (corpus elsewhere uses 'raiz conjuntiva').
findings.current: raiz conetiva de 話す (話し), antes do passado た
findings.suggested: raiz conectiva de 話す (話し), antes do passado た

findings.issue: pt-BR note uses 'conetiva' (European-Portuguese orthography); pt-BR spelling is 'conectiva'. Same defect as in sent:tatoeba-213512.
findings.current: raiz conetiva de なる (なり), antes de ます
findings.suggested: raiz conectiva de なる (なり), antes de ます

findings.issue: その is the medial demonstrative 'that'; lit_en renders it 'this pipe', clashing with the token gloss ('that, near the listener') and lit_pt ('esse cano').
findings.current: As for this pipe, it carries water from the lake to the factory.
findings.suggested: As for that pipe, it carries water from the lake to the factory.

findings.issue: ホテル is a noun, not an adverb; 'advérbio de lugar' conflates word class with function. In pt-BR grammar the function label is 'adjunto adverbial de lugar'.
findings.suggested: local de existência (adjunto adverbial de lugar)

findings.issue: ぬれ is a verb (ぬれる); the role labels it 'adjetivo', contradicting the token's own note. ぬれた modifies シャツ as an adnominal (relative-clause) verb form.
findings.suggested: verbo em função adnominal (modificador do substantivo)
